body:
## Ring Road Block plot prices

The published schedule effective 2 November 2026 lists seven sizes and discounted prices with plot number: 5.56 Marla at PKR 3,380,000; 8 Marla at PKR 4,650,000; 10.89 Marla at PKR 6,150,000; 14.22 Marla at PKR 7,690,000; 1 Kanal at PKR 10,390,000; 2 Kanal (75 × 120) at PKR 19,990,000; and 2 Kanal (80 × 120) at PKR 21,190,000. Request confirmation of current availability for your preferred size.

## Full-payment options

The listed Ring Road Block prices are on a full-payment basis. Ask for a written quotation showing the discounted price with plot number, registration, any location premium and the complete payable amount.

## Registration and location premiums

The schedule lists PKR 20,000 registration and states development charges are included. Preferred locations may have additional premiums: 15% for main-road corner plots, 10% for main-road plots or proper-corner plots, and 5% for short-corner plots or plots with green area, lake, front or back open space. Request confirmation of the category and calculation for the exact plot.

## Check the plot location

Ask for a current block plan with the plot number marked and a location pin. Arrange a site visit or request a recent walkthrough to review road access, plot boundaries and the surrounding area.

## Request your shortlist

Share your preferred plot size, budget and location preference. Ask for current plot options, location details and an itemized quotation.
